panels.content_two_col:
The Proven WordPress Stack for Rapid Innovation

Built on a customized, enterprise-grade WordPress environment, Yoke delivers a powerful foundation your teams and clients already trust.  
  • Familiar and flexible: Built on the world’s leading publishing platform.
  • Rapid innovation: Launch new formats and digital learning products without retooling.
  • Client-ready integration: Connect easily to client systems, analytics, and innovation pipelines.
  • Governed and compliant: Secure, auditable workflows for editorial, regulatory, and commercial teams.
  • Multi-stakeholder collaboration: Align internal and external teams across one governed environment.
 

A platform you know — built for what’s next.

AI Confidence & Proof You Can Act On

AI that drives growth — and proof that earns trust. Yoke’s AI is fully integrated and governed, giving publishers the power to personalize, predict, and prove with confidence.  
  • AI Search & Recommendations: Surface relevant content and predict engagement.
  • Personalized learning: Automatically adapts to role, region, and behavior.
  • Explainable insights: Every recommendation is transparent and auditable.
  • Live Proof dashboards: Track engagement, learning lift, and ROI in real time.
  • Behavioral analytics: Understand what’s working, what isn’t, and how to improve.
  • Client-ready reporting: Demonstrate ROI to sponsors, funders, and partners instantly.
 

Smart AI. Safe AI. Measurable proof.

Activate, Expand, and Scale

Turn your existing content into measurable engagement and global growth.  
  • Instant activation: Upload pre-approved PDFs, PowerPoints, or videos — instantly convert to interactive, trackable modules.
  • Automated personalization: Deliver AI-recommended content for every learner or audience.
  • Centralized control: Manage global teams, affiliates, and regions from one dashboard.
  • Localization in hours: Translate, adapt, and deploy new markets instantly.
  • Omnichannel delivery: Consistent experiences across live, digital, and self-serve channels.
 

Reuse what you’ve built. Expand where you can. Prove what it delivers.

The Payoff — Proof. Speed. Scale.

Yoke transforms medical publishing from content creation to measurable impact.
  • Prove value and ROI for every learning product.
  • Accelerate innovation through integrated AI and WordPress agility.
  • Monetize existing assets through instant productization.
  • Expand globally with localization and affiliate enablement.
  • Unify your stack within one governed environment.
 

Yoke — The AI-Powered WordPress Platform for Proof, Speed & Scale.

YOKE POWERS THE NEXT GENERATION OF MEDICAL PUBLISHERS

Designed and proven for:
  • Medical publishers and learning providers
  • CME / IME organizations
  • MedComms and digital education specialists
  • Healthcare communication innovators
 

Book a 25-min strategy call  today

panels.content_cta_small:

Built by MedComms and publishing specialists who understand CME, IME, compliance, and commercial innovation. panels.content_block:
Prove your content works — from learning lift to ROI.

Show clients, sponsors, and funders measurable learning outcomes, behavioral change, and engagement proof — all from the content you already own.   Book a 25-min strategy call  today   See how Yoke delivers personalized, two-way learning, live proof, and new revenue growth — instantly.
